Data Values:
0 = not configured/not used
1 = not used
2 = shutdown - network
3 = full manual control
4 = standby
5 = online (running)
6 = online (filling)
7 = filling
8 = shutdown – fault
9 = group standby
10 = not used
11 = not used
12 = tank filling

1 = no ATS
2 = On A, B available
3 = On A, B not available
4 = On B (A not available)
